name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: A back-room gambling den at every port of size 6 or more. Sell surplus hulls for tokens. Play Slots with one to five reels at 1, 2, 4 or 8 tokens per reel, or play Pachinko: choose hullmods, weapons or tokens and drop 1, 10 or 50 balls. Keep adding balls as they bounce off pegs and each other. Each landing pocket pays its displayed quantity. Collect all Pachinko winnings when you leave the screen. Hullmod rewards skip blueprints you already know or carry. Ball prices, pocket amounts, crate sizes and slot odds have LunaLib sliders.
